invalidation_conditions: A decisive daily close above the $1255.00 window high on abnormally high volume.

proposal.thesis: The market is dangerously extrapolating peak cyclical earnings (annualized ~$100 EPS) into a permanent plateau, leaving zero margin of safety. Parabolic revenue growth sets an intensely high hurdle for further sequential acceleration; any slight quarterly deceleration risks severe simultaneous multiple and earnings compression. The stock is nearing its $1,255 window high without supportive volume expansion, while the closest technical support rests ~30% lower at $854, presenting an extremely asymmetric downside profile. Given the structural volatility of the memory cycle and compounding risks of industry capacity additions, we short the impending late-cycle exhaustion.
premortem_top_risks: Bull Failure: The memory cycle turns due to aggressive capacity additions or hyperscaler capex deceleration, causing the market to violently de-rate the stock as both peak earnings and the peak multiple compress simultaneously.

Bear Failure: HBM supply constraints remain structural, allowing MU to sustain or sequentially exceed its supernormal quarterly earnings, forcing the market to re-rate the stock toward the $1,500 upper fair-value bound as the cycle duration stretches.
